verses.en: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout unto the LORD, all the earth.

verses.he: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃
verses.en: Serve the LORD with gladness; Come before His presence with singing.

verses.he: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ ולא [וְל֣וֹ] אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Know ye that the LORD He is God; It is He that hath made us, and we are His, His people, and the flock of His pasture.

verses.he: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו׀ בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ־ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise; Give thanks unto Him, and bless His name.

verses.he: כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: For the LORD is good; His mercy endureth for ever; And His faithfulness unto all generations.
